title: Constant volume calculation
hints: The reaction supplies the gained heat.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $q_\mathrm{cal}=9.50(1.20)=11.4$ kJ. Thus $q_v=\Delta E=-11.4$ kJ for the sample.
statement:
A rigid bomb’s calibrated heat capacity is $9.50$ kJ/K and its temperature rises $1.20$ K. What is $\Delta E$ of the combustion sample?

[_]{a}

explanations: Negative heat is assigned to the reaction.
Temperature rise must be multiplied by heat capacity.
